POLICE RULES, 1934
POLICE RULES, 1934
(Amendment of Rr.13.6 and 13.7)
[Gazette of Punjab, Part III,
12th December, 2012]
No.6595/T-II,
dated 17-7-2012.---In exercise of the powers conferred under Article 112 of the
Police Order, 2002 (22 of 2002), the Provincial Police Officer, with the
approval of Government of Punjab, is pleased to direct that in the Police
Rules, 1934, the following amendments shall be made:--
In
the said Rules:
(a) For
rule 13.06, the following shall be substituted:
"13.6
List 'A' Promotion to be selection grade of Constables.---List 'A' (in Form
13.6) shall be maintained by each Superintendent of Police, under his personal
supervision, of constables who are not more than thirty seven years of age and
are eligible under rules 13.5 for promotion to the selection grade of
constables. The number of names in the list shall not exceed twenty per cent of
the establishment of the grade in the district."; and
(b) In
rule 13.7, at the end, following Explanation shall be inserted:
"Explanation:
I.
List 'B-I' shall be maintained in each district under this rule for those
constables who have qualified List 'A' and are not more than, thirty nine years
of age.
II.
The number of constables in List 'B' (in the Form 13.7) shall not exceed five
per cent of the establishment of the grade in the district."
